from typing import List, Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

# Define the 8 legal cause categories as Literals based on the task description
Category = Literal[
    "行政主体 - 劳动和社会保障行政管理（劳动，社会保障）",
    "行政行为 - 行政确认",
    "用益物权纠纷",
    "执行案由 - 民事",
    "民事案由 - 合同，无因管理，不当得利纠纷",
    "行政行为 - 行政登记",
    "执行案由 - 其他案由",
    "行政行为 - 行政撤销"
]

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Record of a single legal document extracted by the parser."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    categories: List[Category] = Field(description="The list of legal cause categories applicable to this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of all documents in the collection."""
    documents: List[DocumentRecord]
